page.overview:
Who is Raif Oslow?

Raif Oslow was a soldier of House Atreides.

Raif Oslow was born on Caladan. He became a street thug and was eventually sentenced to serve on a prison planet for his crimes. He was saved from this fate when Tighe Skorda of the Constabulary intervened. Skorda saw something in Oslow and covered up his crimes, recruiting him into the House Forces of House Atreides.

Oslow was approached by the Prisoner in Arrakeen. They asked him about Skorda's whereabouts and he told them of how Skorda recruited him. He then told them that he had last seen Skorda speaking to a recruiter from the Maas Kharet.
